incident_text: Support tickets since about 09:40 UTC: users asking about order status on WhatsApp keep getting 'Sorry, I couldn't fetch that right now'. Balance questions seem fine.

changes.title: perf: tighten broker tool timeout for faster replies
changes.author: vikram

truth.description: A commit lowered the broker tool timeout in config/app.json from 5s to 0.5s; the partner broker API's normal latency (~450ms median) now exceeds it for a large share of calls, so order-status questions get the apology reply.

trap: The broker API itself is healthy (latency unchanged); a sender deploy lands just before. The fault is our own timeout config, visible only in the diff.
